Newsroom Charter & Code of Ethics

Editorial Policy

Last Updated: November 2026 • Document Ref: NYH-ED-2026.11

Our Mission

Newyorkerherald is committed to providing accurate, independent, and responsible journalism focused on the United States and its global impact. Our goal is to inform readers through reliable reporting, thoughtful analysis, and meaningful storytelling.

Editorial Independence

All editorial decisions are made independently and are not influenced by advertisers, sponsors, political organizations, governments, or other outside commercial interests. We maintain a strict, inviolable separation between editorial content and commercial operations.

Accuracy and Fairness

We strive to ensure that all published information is accurate, properly sourced, and presented with appropriate context. Our editorial team makes exhaustive efforts to verify facts before publication and update stories promptly when new verified information becomes available.

Corrections Policy

If an error is identified, we review the matter promptly and transparently make corrections when necessary. Maintaining accuracy and accountability is a core part of our editorial process. Correction notices are documented clearly within the respective article text.

Opinion and Analysis

Opinion articles, commentary, and specialized analysis are published alongside news reporting but are strictly labeled. Such content reflects the views of the respective authors and does not necessarily represent the views or institutional positions of Newyorkerherald.

Use of Technology & AI

We may use technology, including artificial intelligence tools, to assist with research and background data synthesis. However, all published content is rigorously vetted and edited by human journalists, and complete editorial responsibility remains solely with our human editorial team.

Reader Engagement & Inquiries

We value feedback from our readers and encourage suggestions, questions, and correction requests. Reader input helps us improve our journalism and uphold the highest professional standards.

Our Commitment to Readers

Newyorkerherald remains dedicated to ethical journalism, transparency, fairness, and accountability while delivering trustworthy coverage of the issues and events shaping the nation and the world.
